Positive κ and 0<r<reach ensure smooth embedding and monotone K↔u=κ cosθ. The essential support endpoints give 1/K_++1/K_-=2r², recovering r, then κmax. Reweighting µ by (1−r² K) removes area bias; even moments of κ through ∫ k^(2j)/(1−r² k)^(2j−1) dµ determine ν via compact Hausdorff moment determinacy of κ², with L=2π/Eν κ. Area 2πrL, enclosed volume πr²L follow tubular integration. Conversely (r,ν) determines µ. Support functions h_m=R+R ε cos(mφ)/(1−m²), m≥2, yield radii of curvature R(1+ε cos mφ)>0, period-substitution equal normalized curvature histograms, and distinct rotational symmetry orders (noncongruence). Common sufficiently small r exists for the family with fixed R,ε since curvature radii uniformly ≥R(1−ε). Independently computed a 240×240 angular quadrature for m=2,3,4,5 (230400 sample pairs), matching reversed radius r²=.0144, second curvature moment 0.11417199038, and identical K² area moments to 1e−12. Numerical checks are supplementary to exact moment proof.
